question: Which Indian state hosted the Khelo India Youth Games in 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** is a flagship initiative by the **Government of India** aimed at promoting sports culture in the country.
 
• In 2025, the **state of Bihar** was chosen to host the prestigious event, showcasing its growing commitment to sports infrastructure and development.
 
• **Bihar** is focusing on creating a conducive environment for young athletes by improving sports facilities and encouraging participation at grassroots levels.
 
• The selection of Bihar as the host state highlights its efforts to rejuvenate its image as an emerging hub for **sports events** in India.
 
• The event is expected to bring together thousands of young athletes from across India, competing in various disciplines, thus fostering unity and sportsmanship.
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games** serves as a platform for identifying and nurturing talent, ensuring that promising athletes receive the support and training they need to excel at national and international levels.
 
• The initiative aligns with the government's vision of making India a global sporting powerhouse by promoting fitness and competitive spirit among its youth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is one of India's largest states and has hosted several important events, but it was not selected to host the Khelo India Youth Games in 2025.
 
• The state is known for its efforts in promoting sports, with initiatives like the **Major Dhyan Chand Sports University** in Meerut.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal**__
 __
 
• **West Bengal** has a rich history of sports, particularly in football and cricket, but it was not the host for the 2025 Khelo India Youth Games.
 
• The state is known for iconic venues like the **Eden Gardens**, one of the largest cricket stadiums in the world.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has been actively promoting sports and was the host for the **Khelo India Youth Games in 2023**, but it was not selected for 2025.
 
• The state has invested in building sports infrastructure, including the **international-level stadiums** and training centers.
